{{Quote|Unfortunately, CEC's shielded against conventional attacks. There's only one way in. The hull-cracker&ndash; a compact bomb, developed by Czerka Corellia's deviant scientists to punch holes through capital ships. It will get us inside CEC.|[[Darth Charnus]] debriefing to his subordinate|<ref name="Czerka">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|Czerka Liquidation|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''hull-cracker''' was an experimental weapon developed by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Jastal]] of the [[Imperial Guard]] helped an Imperial-aligned individual steal the weapon for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]<ref name="Czerka" /> and used it to breach the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] headquarters.<ref name="Corellian Engineering Corporation">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|Industrial Collapse|Corellia}}</ref>
